analysis: The PR changes only docs/developer/test.md: the 'Last updated' stamp moves from 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28, and a new 'Download completion ownership' subsection (head lines 43-53) is added. The subsection describes StreamingFileDownloadDelegateTests, which cover a cancelled suspended URLSession task, completion ordering, duplicate terminal callbacks, attach/complete races and preservation of exact .part bytes on cancel. It states that the fixtures use unique temporary directories, never resume a network task and never load model weights. The supplied units are base text only (lines 475-1389 of the pre-change file), and none of the changed lines appear in them. They contain unchanged surrounding documentation: calibration tests, SSD checkpoint qualification, endpoint resumption/logout, add-on hold, watchdog, App Attest dispatch, native serving qualification and release tooling. The change is documentation only. It adds no executable code, authorization or attestation logic, key handling, wire behavior, cache behavior or configuration. It makes no new security claim. It repeats the existing caveat that component tests do not qualify live downloads or serving. Nothing in the diff touches TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011 or TB-012, nor the T-041 cache posture. One integration question remains outside the supplied evidence: the StreamingFileDownloadDelegate implementation and its tests are not in this batch. Any behavior change in the download path (model-weight integrity per A-004/T-012, partial-file handling) would need review in its own source files. The documentation does not imply a regression.
